home.subtitle: Freelance web developer in Grenoble. I build your custom website, from the first call to launch.

about.title: One
about.description: I'm Téo, a freelance web developer in Grenoble. For 4 years I've been building websites and tools for independents, small businesses and research labs. You talk directly to the person building your site: no agency, no subcontracting. I deliver a fast, clean site that you can keep growing, with or without me. Alongside that, I'm finishing a computer science engineering degree at IMT Nord Europe.
about.quote: I reply within 24 hours, and it's always me who picks up.

experiences.pageDescription: Education and experience of Téo Villet, freelance web developer in Grenoble.

process.description: From your first message to launch.

steps.title: We talk
steps.text: You tell me about your business and what you expect from the site.

steps.title: I send you a quote
steps.text: Each item broken down, with the final price. Take your time to think it over.

steps.title: I build the site
steps.text: You approve the mockup first. During development, you follow progress on a test link.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: I put the site live and show you how to edit your content. I'm still reachable if you need me.
